plan.json: {"ask":"Build my renewal desk with account health from tickets, usage and mail, a risk list and a weekly renewals digest. Make a QBR outline and let me approve a CRM note and Gmail draft.","data":[{"id":"account","line":"Customer accounts and their health"},{"id":"contact","line":"Customer contacts at an account"},{"id":"renewal","line":"Renewals by stage, date and value"},{"id":"ticket","line":"Support tickets that feed account health"},{"id":"usage","line":"Usage and adoption per account"},{"id":"note","line":"CRM notes saved to a renewal"}],"actions":[{"id":"renewal-note","line":"Draft and approve a CRM note saved to a renewal"},{"id":"gmail-draft","line":"Approve a Gmail draft to the account contact"},{"id":"qbr-outline","line":"Make a QBR outline"}],"automation":[{"id":"weekly-digest","line":"Weekly renewals digest"},{"id":"renewal-note","line":"Draft and approve a CRM note saved to a renewal"},{"id":"gmail-draft","line":"Draft and approve a Gmail message to the account contact"},{"id":"qbr-outline","line":"Make a QBR outline"}],"screens":[{"id":"renewals","line":"Renewals by stage board"},{"id":"risk","line":"Renewals and accounts needing attention"},{"id":"renewal","line":"Renewal detail with approve actions"}]}
runs/gmail-draft.yaml:
run: gmail-draft
title: Approve a Gmail draft to the account contact
budget: {per_run: 0.10}
params:
  renewal: {type: ref, to: renewal}
steps:
  - id: draft
    title: Draft the renewal email
    ai:
      prompt: >-
        Draft a short renewal email to {{params.renewal.contact.name}} about
        {{params.renewal.name}}. Thank them for their partnership, mention the
        renewal date {{params.renewal.renewal_date}} and value, and invite them
        to a short call. Do not add a signature.
      output:
        type: object
        required: [subject, body]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          subject:
            type: string
          body:
            type: string
      example:
        subject: Your upcoming renewal
        body: Hi, I wanted to reach out ahead of your upcoming renewal.
  - id: send
    title: Review and send the email
    tool: gmail.send
    args:
      to: $params.renewal.contact.email
      subject: $steps.draft.output.subject
      body: $steps.draft.output.body
    gate:
      approval: send
      who: $me
runs/qbr-outline.yaml:
run: qbr-outline
title: Make a QBR outline
budget: {per_run: 0.10}
params:
  renewal: {type: ref, to: renewal}
steps:
  - id: outline
    title: Draft the QBR outline
    ai:
      prompt: >-
        Write a one-page quarterly business review outline for account
        {{params.renewal.account.name}}. Cover results so far, product
        adoption, support themes and the renewal plan for
        {{params.renewal.renewal_date}}.
      output:
        type: object
        required: [title, body]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          title:
            type: string
          body:
            type: string
      example:
        title: QBR outline for Northwind
        body: '1. Results  2. Adoption  3. Support themes  4. Renewal plan'
  - id: save
    title: Save the QBR outline as a note
    records.create:
      type: note
      set:
        title: $steps.outline.output.title
        body: $steps.outline.output.body
        account: $params.renewal.account.id
        renewal: $params.renewal.id
runs/renewal-note.yaml:
run: renewal-note
title: Approve a CRM note for a renewal
budget: {per_run: 0.10}
params:
  renewal: {type: ref, to: renewal}
steps:
  - id: draft
    title: Draft the CRM note
    ai:
      prompt: >-
        Draft a concise internal CRM note about the renewal referenced by
        {{params.renewal.name}} for account {{params.renewal.account.name}}.
        Cover the current stage, renewal date, value and risk, plus the next
        step for the account owner. Do not add a signature.
      output:
        type: object
        required: [title, body]
        additionalProperties: false
        properties:
          title:
            type: string
          body:
            type: string
      example:
        title: Renewal note for Northwind
        body: Northwind is in negotiation on their renewal; confirm pricing next.
  - id: save
    title: Save the CRM note for approval
    records.create:
      type: note
      set:
        title: $steps.draft.output.title
        body: $steps.draft.output.body
        renewal: $params.renewal.id
        account: $params.renewal.account.id
    gate:
      approval: proof
      who: $me
runs/weekly-digest.yaml:
run: weekly-digest
title: Weekly renewals digest
budget: {per_run: 0.10}
steps:
  - id: digest
    title: Render the weekly renewals digest
    render:
      output: renewals-digest
      inbox: true
